newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: First Provincial no comment on merge report.
newsitem.headline: First Provincial no comment on merge report.

text.p: First Provincial Building Society Ltd said on Wednesday that executives were not available to comment on a newspaper report that it was about to merge with the unlisted Sunstate Credit Union.
Brisbane-based Sunstate also said it could not comment on the report in The Australian Financial Review newspaper.

First Provincial, based in Ipswich just west of Brisbane, has a market capitalisation of A$36.66 million and total assets of A$559.98 million. First Provincial sought a share trading halt earlier on Wednesday pending an announcement.
